snippet.title: How Long Is GTA 6? Story Length Explained #GTA6
snippet.description:
How long is GTA 6? Reviewers finished the main story in about 50 hours, way longer than GTA 5's roughly 32. Rockstar's Rob Nelson says his run took about 80 hours with the optional side goals that shape the story, and 100% completion is estimated at up to 200 hours.

Status: REPORTED by reviewers and press. Rockstar has not published an official story length. Times vary with play style; "100%" is an estimate.
Sources: Screen Rant (50 h 42 min main story run) · critic roundups (50–70 h) · Rob Nelson's ~80 h playthrough as reported by Make Tech Easier · HowLongToBeat-style estimates for GTA 5 (~32 h main story).
Images: GTA VI screenshots by Rockstar Games (official GTA VI media, rockstargames.com/VI/media). Graphics: original by Mile Zero. Voice: AI-generated.
